purpose: Frozen accuracy reference for the EXL3 SM86 workstream. Do not replace with GLM or other-model KLD numbers.

kld.calibration_note: 512 samples (307 neuralmagic chat + 205 Rombo reasoning), seq 2048. EXL3 conversion uses the same 512x2048 dimensions.

mixed_autoround_gs32_72g.byte_size_note: du -sh reports the rounded value 72G. Record exact bytes with `du -sb` on the Linux host when capturing the stack manifest.

exl3_quality_gates.minimum_note: Must not exceed the original AWQ floor. Substantial VRAM saving vs 72G is required.
exl3_quality_gates.stretch_note: Approach the current 72 GiB mixed AutoRound winner. Do not compare against unrelated GLM KLD numbers.
